name: Ryoujoku Kangofu Gakuin
source:
Yumi Asakura is a young, pretty and naive girl who is making an effort to become, one day, a great nurse. In the hospital where she works, everybody wants to make out with her, even the head doctor and the other nurses, and she is forced to practice unusual techniques to help patients feel better. But she thinks that it is the only way to become a great nurse, so she does not complain much and does whatever she is told to do.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=4891]ANN[/url]]
translation:
朝仓由美是一名年轻、漂亮且天真的女孩，努力成为一名优秀护士。在她工作的医院里，每个人都想与她发生关系，甚至包括主任医师和其他护士；她被迫练习不寻常的技巧，让病人感觉更好。但她认为这是成为优秀护士的唯一办法，因此很少抱怨，并照吩咐做任何事。

[摘自[url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=4891]ANN[/url]]
